boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Cal Poly Maritime Academy
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food runs around Vallejo and nearby American Canyon, each verified through a current official location page showing service at midnight or later.

cards.title: The All-Night Solano Stop
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour drive-through option in central Vallejo
cards.notes: Use the Solano Avenue drive-through when the timing is unpredictable; confirm holiday service in the app before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A continuously operating drive-through for meals at virtually any hour.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page identifies the restaurant at 2033 Solano Avenue and lists drive-through hours as 12:00 AM–12:00 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Vallejo, CA — 2033 Solano Avenue
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the drive-through as open 24 hours daily. Late-night access is drive-through service; holiday hours may vary.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 400 Broadway Street
cards.title: Broadway After Midnight
cards.subtitle: All-night drive-through service on Vallejo's west side
cards.notes: Choose the Broadway drive-through after the 10:00 PM lobby closure, and check the official page again before a holiday trip.
cards.short_summary: A west-Vallejo option whose drive-through continues after its dining room closes.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official page identifies the 400 Broadway Street restaurant and displays drive-through hours as 4:00 AM–4:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 400 Broadway St, Vallejo
cards.access_notes: Drive-through service is listed as 24 hours daily. The lobby is listed from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM, so late access requires a vehicle.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 1610 Lewis Brown Drive
cards.title: The Lewis Brown Overnight Run
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour drive-through near northern Vallejo
cards.notes: Plan on drive-through access after 10:00 PM; use the official location page to recheck service before setting out late.
cards.short_summary: An overnight northern-Vallejo run with a separately documented lobby cutoff.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Jack in the Box page lists 1610 Lewis Brown Drive and shows drive-through hours of 4:00 AM–4:00 AM seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 1610 Lewis Brown Dr, Vallejo
cards.access_notes: The drive-through is listed as operating 24 hours daily; the lobby closes at 10:00 PM each night.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 35 Admiral Callaghan Lane
cards.title: Admiral Callaghan After Hours
cards.subtitle: All-night drive-through service east of downtown Vallejo
cards.notes: Use this branch by vehicle after its 9:00 PM lobby closure, and verify current hours online before making the cross-town run.
cards.short_summary: A late drive-through whose dining room closes earlier than nearby branches.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official page lists the 35 Admiral Callaghan Lane location with drive-through hours of 4:00 AM–4:00 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 35 Admiral Callaghan Ln, Vallejo
cards.access_notes: Drive-through service is listed as 24 hours daily. The lobby closes at 9:00 PM, making a vehicle necessary later at night.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Sonoma Boulevard Window
cards.subtitle: Round-the-clock drive-through service in north Vallejo
cards.notes: Treat this as a vehicle-based run after the lobby period; check the restaurant page for temporary or holiday changes first.
cards.short_summary: A continuously available drive-through on one of Vallejo's main north–south routes.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official restaurant page identifies 3289 Sonoma Boulevard and lists its drive-through as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: The drive-through is officially listed as open 24 hours every day. Lobby hours are more limited, so do not assume indoor late-night access.

cards.title: Sonoma Boulevard's 3:00 AM Window
cards.subtitle: Drive-through service until 2:00 or 3:00 AM
cards.notes: Save this for a Friday or Saturday 3:00 AM cutoff; on other nights, plan to arrive before the listed 2:00 AM close.
cards.short_summary: A weekend-oriented late run with later Friday and Saturday drive-through hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page lists drive-through service at 3600 Sonoma Boulevard until 2:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Vallejo, CA — 3600 Sonoma Blvd
cards.access_notes: Drive-through hours end at 2:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday–Saturday. The official page shows much earlier dine-in hours.

cards.title: The 1:30 AM Weekend Run
cards.subtitle: Dine-in and drive-through service past midnight
cards.notes: Arrive before 1:00 AM on weeknights or 1:30 AM Friday and Saturday; verify special-day hours on the location page.
cards.short_summary: A late destination with both dine-in seating and drive-through access documented.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's official Vallejo page lists normal hours until 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday–Saturday, with dine-in and drive-through available.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — Vallejo, 720 Admiral Callaghan Ln
cards.access_notes: Normal hours are 10:30 AM–1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 AM–1:30 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in and drive-through are listed.

cards.title: Redwood Street Until 1:00 AM
cards.subtitle: Restaurant and drive-through hours align nightly
cards.notes: Use this for a before-1:00 AM stop and leave enough time to order; recheck the page because holiday schedules can differ.
cards.short_summary: A consistent seven-night option with both restaurant and drive-through hours shown.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official page lists the restaurant at 1001 Redwood Street as open from 6:30 AM to 1:00 AM every day, with identical drive-through hours.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through service are both listed until 1:00 AM seven days a week. The page cautions that holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: The Midnight Fairgrounds Diner
cards.subtitle: A sit-down option serving through midnight
cards.notes: Choose this when indoor seating matters, but arrive well before the midnight close and confirm same-day hours before traveling.
cards.short_summary: A late sit-down alternative to the area's drive-through-heavy overnight choices.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official location page identifies the restaurant at 250 Fairgrounds Drive and lists daily restaurant hours from 6:00 AM to 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: The official restaurant schedule runs until 12:00 AM daily. Arrive before closing and contact the location to confirm holiday hours.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 107 West American Canyon Road
cards.title: The American Canyon Overnight Detour
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour lobby and drive-through north of Vallejo
cards.notes: Use this farther north option when walk-in access matters overnight; verify the live page before committing to the extra distance.
cards.short_summary: A nearby overnight destination with late lobby access documented, not only a drive-through.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official page identifies 107 West American Canyon Road and lists both lobby and drive-through hours as 4:00 AM–4:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 107 W American Canyon Rd
cards.access_notes: Both lobby and drive-through are listed as operating 24 hours daily. This destination is in American Canyon, north of Vallejo.
